title: Defcon 21 - Decapping Chips The Strike Easy Hard Way
summary: A DEF CON 21 talk by Adam Laurie and Zac Franken on decapping chips, covering how to remove chip packaging and image the die to read out contents such as ROM.
why: Regarded as a favorite practical walkthrough of chip decapping, linked in threads on die shots, hardware backdoors and key extraction.

quote.text: One of my favourite talks is Decapping Chips the Hard Way by Adam Laurie and Zac Franken
